# 5 bed detached house for sale

> Sherry FitzGerald Todd are delighted to bring to the market this Architecturally Designed 5-Bedroom A0-Rated Bungalow in a tranquil rural setting Lavally, Tuam, Co. Galway. This brand-new A0-Rated, architecturally designed bungalow offers the perfect blend of modern comfort and peaceful countryside living.
